rules.title: utf8mb4
rules.text: Use utf8mb4 with a modern collation for all tables.

rules.title: InnoDB
rules.text: Use InnoDB tables with foreign keys and explicit primary keys.

rules.title: Explain slow queries
rules.text: Check slow queries with EXPLAIN and add composite indexes in selective order.

rules.title: Online schema changes
rules.text: Use online schema change tools for large tables.
